title: Grandma's cooking workshops make you feel the love of home
text: I absolutely loved the Grandma's Cooking Workshops and definitely had to return more times. The celebrations we had together were so much fun and I felt so much love from all the abuelas. They taught us how to cook delicious, traditional Spanish dishes like fideuà, paella, tortilla, tapas, and sangria. We helped through every step of the process, from cutting the vegetables to flipping the pan and taking in all the rich smells. They were patient and genuine, treating us like their own and feeding us so well. It was really special to learn authentic recipes that they brought to us from their ho
author: S3276LBmeganp

title: Great experience, wonderful people, fun night out with our kids!
text: What a fun night!  Veronica, Cali and the rest of the crew welcomed us and our kids with warmth and kindness into their lovely kitchen, where we spent a fun evening cooking the most delicious meal. Cali was spectacular. I loved learning some of her special family recipes (the meatballs!!), and my kids felt right at home. After 10 days of restaurant eating on our vacation, this was a welcome change of pace. Surprisingly relaxing and full of laughs. Thank you for a fantastic evening!  Highly recommend!!
author: sarspm

title: Top tips from Grandma
text: we enjoyed a good evening with Yves and Conchita, our self taught Grandma cook. Set in a relaxed and informal setting of someone's home in the centre of Barcelona we had a hands on experience preparing a 3 course meal and learning some new techniques - great for beginners or amateur chefs
author: mrgribbo

title: Must do while in Barcelona!
text: My friend and I were looking for something unique to do while traveling in Barcelona. We came across Grandma's Cooking and decided to give it a shot! Yves was an excellent host and made sure that our night was incredible. We prepared a traditional Catalan meal with our Grandma and then had an enjoyable dinner. The conversation during dinner was also a highlight for me. I think it is a great way to immerse yourself and experience a different culture. Our Grandma had a great sense of humor, but also made sure that we were learning her cooking style and secrets. I recommend this to anyone looking
author: Kevin G

title: Great family feel in a foreign country!!!
text:
Great experience and well organized.
You’re warmly greeted and welcomed into the kitchen with plenty of extra hands, so no dishes or cleanup.  Charming team with excellent English.  Would be 5 star, but meat used for main dish was lowest level possible.  Sides and dessert were excellent!  Main dish was tasty, except for the quality of the meat used.  Would still do this again in a New York minute.  Wonderful experience.  We did it with 4 couples.  Ton of fun and laughs!
Drinks were provided.
author: cmignanelli
